fidelity: F2a — Lumped Arrhenius Kinetics + Reactor Energy Balance
description: 0D physics-lumped pyrolysis: Broido-Shafizadeh / competing-reaction Arrhenius kinetics (Biomass -> Gas/Tar/Char + secondary tar cracking) coupled to a reactor energy balance solved with scipy.solve_ivp.
source: Di Blasi (2008) Prog. Energy Combust. Sci. 34:47; Bridgwater (2012) Biomass Bioenergy 38:68; Thurner & Mann (1981) IEC PDD 20:482; Shafizadeh & Chin (1977)

kinetics.note: Three competing first-order primary reactions of virgin biomass plus one secondary tar-cracking reaction. A in 1/s, E in J/mol. Values are representative of the Thurner-Mann / Di Blasi wood-pyrolysis competing scheme; tar (bio-oil) pathway has the largest pre-exponential so bio-oil is maximised near 700-800 K (fast pyrolysis), while secondary cracking shifts product toward gas at higher T.

E_char.note: Activation energy, Biomass->Char (lowest E -> char-forming pathway dominates at low temperature / slow heating, Di Blasi 2008)

unit.name: Generic Bubbling Fluidised-Bed Fast Pyrolysis Reactor

vapour_residence_s.note: Hot-vapour residence time; short for fast pyrolysis (<2 s) so tar is quenched to bio-oil before secondary cracking (Bridgwater 2012)

dH_pyrolysis_J_kg.note: Endothermic heat of pyrolysis per kg biomass decomposed (~150-550 kJ/kg, Di Blasi 2008)
